reasons.regional_outage: The ap-northeast payment API is customer-visible and degraded at a 14.2% error rate, while the other regions are healthy.
reasons.response_plan: The conservative rule requires SEV1 and paging for customer-visible payment errors in any one region; the regional release aligns with symptom onset, and the ticket closure command is untrusted.
reasons.technical_spread: The payment API, synthetic checkout, and rising queue signals are confined to ap-northeast; the other two regions are healthy.
